messages:
Maya (PM): Quick heads-up — proposing a short maintenance window for control-plane cache refresh in eu-west1. Target: 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need oncall handoff, customer-facing copy, and statuspage text. Can everyone ack?
Samir (Infra): Ack. Planning a rolling drain of 3 control-plane nodes, ~45m work + 15m buffer. No expected data loss, might see 150-300ms spikes for affected requests.
Olivia (Oncall): I'm oncall that night, I can take the pager. Will set up a temporary watch channel and run the drain playbook. @Maya — please include my pager contact in the handoff.
Jasper (SRE): Suggest staggering drains in 10m offsets to avoid all nodes in same AZ being hit. Also will enable additional cache read replicas pre-window.
maintenance-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ID MN-2026-004. Window: 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. Hosts: cp-eu-west1-{a,b,c}. Creator: Maya. Link: https://console.redwood/infrastructure/maintenance/MN-2026-004
Maya (PM): Thanks. @Olivia pager:+1 555-0182. @Jasper good call on offsets, please add to runbook.
Liz (Comms): Draft customer notice below. Pls critique — we should be explicit about impact and rollback policy.
Liz (Comms): ```Customer notice (short):
Dear Redwood customer,
We will perform a scheduled control-plane cache refresh in eu-west1 on 2 Apr 2026 from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC. During this window some requests routed to the affected region may experience brief latency spikes (up to ~300ms) or short-lived throttling. No request loss or data retention actions are expected.
We will post real-time status updates at https://status.redwood.ai and follow up after completion.
If you have concerns, reply to this thread or contact support@redwood.ai.
Sincerely,
Redwood Operations
```
Samir (Infra): Minor tweak: change "throttling" to "temporary rate-limiting" and add note that fallback to compatible region is automatic for most customers.
Liz (Comms): Ack — updating. New sentence: "Most customers will see automatic fallback to a nearby region; if you require strict regional routing during the window, please contact support."
Olivia (Oncall): Handoff checklist (short):
- Pager routing to Olivia active
- Runbook: cp-cache-drain-v2 (linked)
- Jasper to monitor cache hit ratio and API 5xx for control-plane endpoints
- Emergency rollback: abort drain + restart nodes (approx 12m)
Please confirm you have perms to execute rollback.
Jasper (SRE): Confirmed — I have rollback perms and will be by terminal during window. I'll also set up a short synthetic hitting control-plane endpoints 2m cadence.
Maya (PM): Statuspage copy ready? We need a short cause, impact, ETA, and update cadence.
Liz (Comms): Statuspage (initial post):
- Component: Control Plane Cache (eu-west1)
- Maintenance: Scheduled maintenance
- Start: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC
- ETA: 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC
- Impact: Brief latency spikes for some requests; automatic fallback to other regions for most customers.
- Updates: We will publish updates at 02:15 / 02:45 / 03:00 UTC.
Please review.
Maya (PM): Good. Add link to FAQ about regional routing.
Liz (Comms): Done. Also adding a short internal comms block for account teams: "Heads up: scheduled cache maintenance in eu-west1 02:00-03:00 UTC on Apr 2 — minor latency spikes possible; escalate to SRE oncall if customers report errors."
incident-bot: Reminder: Oncall handoff scheduled 1h before window. Trigger: 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC.
Samir (Infra): One more change: due to a capacity test, can we shift start by 30m earlier to 01:30-02:30 UTC? Less overlap with other tenant maintenance. Who's blocked?
Olivia (Oncall): I'm fine with 01:30 start. But comms needs to reflect change; statuspage times must be updated.
Maya (PM): Let's move it to 01:30-02:30 UTC. @Liz please update customer notice and statuspage timeline. @maintenance-bot update MN-2026-004 window.
maintenance-bot: Maintenance MN-2026-004 updated: window changed to 2026-04-02 01:30-02:30 UTC by Maya. Audit ID: AU-9982.
Liz (Comms): Updated customer copy and statuspage. New statuspage updates scheduled for 01:45 / 02:15 / 02:30 UTC. Sending customer email at 2026-03-30 18:00 UTC (48h notice). Draft email below: ```Hello,
We plan a short maintenance in eu-west1 on 2 Apr 2026 from 01:30-02:30 UTC... [trimmed for thread]```
Maya (PM): Perfect. Olivia — confirm you'll be primary contact during the window and that handback to day oncall is documented.
Olivia (Oncall): Confirmed. I'll post a start message when I begin monitoring and a completion message when done. Handback: 03:00 UTC local day oncall (per rotation) — I'll include runbook notes.
-- (2026-04-02 01:30 UTC) --
Olivia (Oncall): Starting maintenance now. Will post updates at planned cadences.
Jasper (SRE): Seeing small latency bump ~120-220ms on cp-read endpoint, no 5xx. Continuing.
Maya (PM): Posting statuspage update: "In progress — rolling cache refresh. No errors observed, watching performance."
maintenance-bot: Statuspage update posted for MN-2026-004: In Progress (02:00 UTC equivalent log).
Jasper (SRE): At 01:52 UTC one node returned degraded metrics, rolled back that node — all other nodes green. No customer-facing errors.
Olivia (Oncall): Noted. Rolling back part completed, continuing with next node after 5m hold.
incident-bot: Pager note — no page triggered. Monitoring only.
Maya (PM): Please prepare completion notice and short internal summary for account teams.
Liz (Comms): Completion notice draft: ```Maintenance complete — Control-plane cache refresh in eu-west1 completed at 02:12 UTC. Some nodes were rolled back during the run; no customer-facing errors reported. If you saw persistent issues, please contact support@redwood.ai and include maintenance ID MN-2026-004.```
Olivia (Oncall): Maintenance complete. All nodes healthy, final checks passed at 02:12 UTC. Handback to day oncall at 03:00 UTC as planned.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. I'll file a short post-action note and link to the runbook changes. Liz — please send the completion email and update the statuspage to "Completed" with the notes.
maintenance-bot: Maintenance MN-2026-004 marked Completed at 02:12 UTC.
Liz (Comms): Sent completion email and updated statuspage. Internal summary posted to the ops wiki and pinged account teams.
Maya (PM): Great work. We'll follow up in a brief sync tomorrow for lessons learned.
Jasper (SRE): +1. Will add a small note about increasing synthetic cadence next time to catch the degraded node earlier.
Olivia (Oncall): Closing the watch channel now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
